postings.title: AI Native Account Executive
postings.description:
Would you relish the opportunity to sell world-class class AI products?

Are you passionate about artificial intelligence and ensuring customer success?

Join our team that provides solutions!

Akamai is seeking an AI Native Account Executive to join our rapidly expanding Infrastructure as a Service team. We're helping power the next wave of AI-driven transformation. Partnering with some of the largest and most advanced companies in the world. Placing you right at the forefront of cloud infrastructure and AI computingwhere speed, scale, and creativity redefine what's possible.

Work with our future customers!

Drive new-logo acquisition and major cloud transformations across UK&I's fastest-growing sectors, i.e. Startups, Digital Natives, SaaS and Fintechs. Owning the full sales journey, from opening doors to winning complex, high-value deals, partnering across teams to deliver compelling GTM strategies. Bring value-based selling expertise, commercial ambition and a passion for emerging technology to a high-performance growth environment.

As a Major Account Executive, you will be responsible for:

- Executing a global outbound prospecting strategy to generate high-quality pipeline and drive new logo acquisition across targeted verticals and regions.

- Have relevant sales experience in Net New Cloud Sales (infrastructure or Software) in the B2B Enterprise market

- Have deep technical and commercial expertise of power capacity, advanced cooling solutions, and the complex financial modeling for large scale deployments.

- Have a proven track record of navigating and closing massive infrastructure and data center deals at the highest enterprise levels.

- Have demonstrated success building and maintaining strategic partner relationships

- Have proven success and an entrepreneurial mindset.

Expectations of being present in the London Office, engaged to lead by example, foster collaboration, and strengthen partnerships at the HQ to accelerate strategic alignment and execution whilst working across multiple time zones and adapting to early mornings or late nights to ensure global alignment, execution, and results.

postings.title: Akamai Technical Academy - November 9th, 2026 - February 26th, 2027
postings.description:
Are you an eager learner, ready to jump into technical training?

Are you looking to build core technical skills for a career in tech?

Apply to Akamai Technical Academy!

Akamai Technical Academy (ATA) (now on Pluralsight) is specifically designed to prepare individuals without technical backgrounds for a career in tech. No prior experience is required. If you are an agile learner, self-starter, and committed to spending time in training, we encourage you to apply.

ATA Aloha Page: https://ac-aloha.akamai.com/home/ls/content/5358597605163008/akamai-technical-academy

About the Training

Akamai Technical Academy is a 12-week hands-on learning program offered through the platform Pluralsight. Modules are designed to help you gain foundational skills in areas such as Linux, networking, web applications, and security. As a participant, you will engage in structured learning pathways to build the confidence and competence needed for a career in tech. This training program does not constitute employment.

Important Details

- Time Commitment: Learners will spend approximately 10 hours per week over the 12-week program duration, during flexible hours.
- Program Dates: November 9, 2026 – February 26, 2027 (includes scheduled breaks).
- Application Window: Applications open on October 5th and close on October 26th.
- Non-employment: This free training program does not constitute employment.

The ATA Track (instead of job responsibilities)

Pluralsight provides a rigorous, hands-on learning experience. Completion of the program is the first step toward a potential future with Akamai. Successful graduates will be considered for a 6-month Akamai apprenticeship starting in Spring 2027, as well as any other relevant job openings at the time of completion. During the 12-week program, learners will complete 6 courses and gain the following skills:

- Operating Systems Fundamentals: Linux, virtualization, CLI
- Networking Fundamentals: HTTP, TCP, SSH, VPNs, troubleshooting
- Introduction to Web Applications: APIs, HTML, CSS, AI development
- Managing Relational Databases: SQL, database queries
- Python Scripting Fundamentals: Python, debugging, AI coding
- Introduction to IT Security: IoT, cryptography, network security, malware

Do what you love

To be successful in this training program, you will:

- Be proficient in English
- Have strong communication and collaboration skills
- Demonstrate a strong desire to learn and ability to be a self-starter with online, self-paced learning modules
- Be available approximately 10 hours per week from November 2026-February 2027 for online learning, hours flexible and self-determined
- Be interested in future apprenticeship and/or job opportunities at the entry level in tech, including Network Operations, Security Architect, Technical Support, and similar roles

Working for you

Through the Akamai Technical Academy program, we will provide you with opportunities to grow, flourish, and achieve great things. Learners will gain the following benefits directly from the program:

- Networking events with former ATA graduates
- Visibility with hiring teams
- Leadership connects
- Career skills coaching
- A guaranteed phone screen with Akamai upon completion
- Opportunity to be considered for apprentice, intern or full-time positions

About us

Akamai powers and protects life online. Leading companies worldwide choose Akamai to build, deliver, and secure their digital experiences — helping billions of people live, work, and play every day. With the world’s most distributed compute platform — from cloud to edge — we make it easy for customers to develop and run applications, while we keep experiences closer to users and threats farther away.

postings.title: Architect
postings.description:
Are you excited to improve the security of systems that power life online for billions of users?

Are you a security architect who enjoys working with developers to help organizations stay safe?

Join our Information Security Team!

Akamai's Information Security team is responsible for safeguarding Akamai, its customers, and the Internet worldwide. We are looking for a Security Architect to join our Product Security team. You will have the opportunity to make the Internet a safer place, powered by the scale of Akamai's platform and influence.

Shape Internet Security

In this role, you will enhance the security of Akamai's products by working closely with development teams to integrate security into the design and development of Akamai systems. AI is changing how we, and our customers, work, and we're excited about it. You'll have room to work with new AI tools, sharpen your skill set, and help drive our strategy.

As an Architect, you will be responsible for:

- Performing security-focused design reviews of applications, systems and networks across a wide range of products, including security, CDN and cloud computing.
- Partnering with development and infrastructure teams across the organization to assist with remediation of identified issues.
- Working collaboratively with product development teams on secure design and development choices.
- Providing guidance and answering questions about security practices.
- Serving as a subject matter expert during incidents and remediation projects.
- Identifying the appropriate tools and processes for ensuring that products are meeting security and compliance requirements.
- Integrating responsible use of AI into your workflow and ensuring that the company's use both internally and its products, are secured.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

- Have experience in security architecture in a large, global environment (identifying architectural security weaknesses at the application, OS, and network level)
- Be current with the latest security technologies, attack techniques, and vulnerabilities.
- Know how to remediate common vulnerabilities and be able to propose custom solutions based on application architecture and implementation.
- Demonstrate breadth of security knowledge across specialties such as cloud security, network security, cryptography, etc.
- Have experience with threat modeling or hazard-analysis frameworks such as STAMP, STRIDE, etc.
- Be able to communicate and collaborate well with a worldwide team, including being able to describe complex security terms to non-technical audiences.

postings.title: Cloud Networking - Senior II Software Engineer
postings.description:
Do you want to help design and implement the next generation of cloud computing?

Do you want to create networking products that enable customers to better use the Akamai Connected Cloud?

Join our Cloud Networking Products team!

Akamai's Connected Cloud (ACC), formerly Linode, consists of collaborative, inclusive, and creative teams. We develop applications and services to empower our customers. Our mission is to accelerate innovation by making cloud computing simple, scalable, affordable, and accessible to all. We design, develop, test, and maintain products that run on our IaaS platform

Shape the future of the Akamai Connected Cloud

- Creating and integrating cloud-networking technologies and architectures
- Developing best practices, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.
- Designing, implementing, reviewing, documenting, and testing high-quality code in close collaboration with your team.

- Have 5+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.

- Have strong proficiency in Python, with the adaptability to learn and work in other languages as needed (particularly C++).

Are you excited by the prospect of creatively solving problems and delivering exceptional

Join Our Global Managed Cloud Operations Team

Shape the Future of the Internet

Join our global Managed Cloud Ops team to solve complex issues for Cloud and Compute customers. Engage with Akamai teams like Engineering, Product, and Sales in a dynamic, growth-focused role.

As a Cloud Operations Architect, You Will Be Responsible For:

- Having skills in aligning customer needs with cloud solutions and infrastructure management.

postings.title: Cloud Support Engineer
postings.description:
Would you like to solve technical challenges for our customers?

Are you passionate about ensuring customer success?

Join our world class Technical Support team

Our Team strives to be the most trusted support services partner. We strive to keep our customers online businesses up and running. We utilize tools, process and knowledge to diagnose and resolve product, platform, and customer issues. We deliver media and security services to proactively maintain quality and protect our customer's online presence.

Make a difference to our business

As a Cloud Support Engineer, you will solve complex technical issues for our customers applying best practice solutions. Through proactively reviewing and mitigating risk, you will minimize any potential service disruptions for some of the top internet companies in Japan

As a Cloud Support Engineer, you will be responsible for:

- Collaborating with customers and internal cross-functional teams to identify, diagnose, resolve and report on technical issues

- Contributing to the strategic direction of the global support team to develop and implement best practices

- Partnering with internal Sales, Services, Engineering and Support teams to ensure customer success on the Akamai platform

- Working independently with the customers manage customer incidents and escalations to closure

- Communicating with customers in Japanese and internal communication in English (Written and Spoken)

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

- Have experience with working on web application issues (HTML, javascript, JSP)

- Be well versed in internet protocols such as HTTP(S), TCP/IP, DNS, SSL, network routing and troubleshooting

- Be experienced in providing technical solutions and support to customers

- Demonstrate ability to communicate professionally with customers and collaborate with internal stakeholders

- Demonstrate a good aptitude for building trusted relationships with customers and providing guidance to wider team members

- Show passion for self improvement and education

- Have fluency to communicate with customers and internal in fluent Japanese and English

Build your career at Akamai

Our ability to shape digital life today relies on developing exceptional people like you. The kind that can turn impossible into possible. We’re doing everything we can to make Akamai a great place to work. A place where you can learn, grow and have a meaningful impact.

With our company moving so fast, it’s important that you’re able to build new skills, explore new roles, and try out different opportunities. There are so many different ways to build your career at Akamai, and we want to support you as much as possible. We have all kinds of development opportunities available, from programs such as GROW and Mentoring, to internal events like the APEX Expo and tools such as Linkedin Learning, all to help you expand your knowledge and experience here.

Learn more

Not sure if this job is the right match for you or want to learn more about the job before you apply? Schedule a 15-minute exploratory call with the Recruiter and they would be happy to share more details.

- Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail with a proven track record of flawlessly executing procedures, checklists, and runbooks.

postings.title: Principal Kernel Engineer
postings.description:
Are you excited by the prospect of working with innovative security products?

Do you enjoy creating innovative and strategic solutions to solve complex problems?

Join Our Team

We build the enforcement agent behind Akamai Guardicore Segmentation, running on millions of workloads across Linux, Windows, and other platforms. It monitors network connections and enforces security policies directly from the kernel in diverse customer environments.

Partner with the best

Join our kernel team, in charge of the network segmentation: building real-time kernel-level enforcement and telemetry for next-generation security products, as well as a new AI Detection and Response (AI-DR) initiative. You’ll develop production-scale software across Linux, Windows, and other platforms, solving complex security challenges. As part of the small senior leaders of the team, you’ll have a direct impact on the product and its technical direction.

As a Principal Kernel Engineer , you will be responsible for:

- Writing and debugging kernel-level C code across our Linux kernel module, Windows kernel driver, and eBPF programs.
- Owning end-to-end debugging of complex production issues, including kernel crashes and low-level system failures, while driving root-cause analysis and post-mortems for production environments.
- Acting as the technical lead for a small team by reviewing critical kernel/eBPF code mentoring engineers, unblocking complex issues, and guiding key technical decisions.

What You'll Bring

To be successful in this role you will:

- Have 5+ years of production C, most of it at the kernel or driver level.
- Have proven production experience with Linux kernel, Windows drivers, or eBPF. Experience across multiple areas is highly preferred.
- Have Hands-on eBPF experience, including writing programs, working with the verifier, and ensuring cross-kernel portability.
- Demonstrate solid understanding of kernel fundamentals, including concurrency, memory safety, and low-level debugging.
- Have experience with kernel software operations, including driver signing, Secure Boot, cross-kernel compatibility, and CI for multi-version environments.
- Possess deep technical judgment and the ability to identify potential issues in kernel code before they reach production.
- Have exceptional ability to debug kernel crashes and other severe bugs.

Build your career at Akamai

Our ability to shape digital life today relies on developing exceptional people like you. The kind that can turn impossible into possible. We’re doing everything we can to make Akamai a great place to work. A place where you can learn, grow and have a meaningful impact.

postings.title: Principal Software Engineer Lead
postings.description:

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will own the design of the control plane that places, reconciles, and operates VMs across the Compute fleet.

As a Principal Software Engineer Lead, you will be responsible for:

- Defining the database partitioning and sharding strategy to scale control plane state management 5x, with capacity models for placement and inventory state.
- Owning the placement reconciliation loop: desired-state model, idempotent reconcilers, drift detection, and reconciliation-lag SLOs.
- Generalizing bulk and asynchronous operations into one model with standard operation resources, batching, concurrency caps, and automatic halt on failure thresholds.
- Setting consistency guarantees per data path, enforcing idempotency and fencing on controller actions, and specifying saga-style workflows.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

- Have 12 years of experience in building distributed systems along with experience in owning control planes or large-scale orchestration or its equivalent
- Have deep database experience with SQL, including partitioning, sharding, replication, and online schema change.
- Have built asynchronous systems: durable task queues, event-driven workflows, and retry and backpressure design.
- Have hands-on experience building and operating containerized applications, including Kubernetes.
- Have good competence in Python or Go; experience with the other or with ColdFusion is good, but not required.
- Have deep understanding of consistency (leases, fencing, idempotency, optimistic concurrency) and hands-on experience with reconciliation or controller patterns (Kubernetes-style controllers or equivalent).

- Data & Observability

postings.title: Senior Technical Marketing Engineer- API Security
postings.description:
Would you like to help define organizations secure the APIs, AI applications, and agentic systems that power modern business?

Are you a product marketer who can go deep technically, turn complex security capabilities into compelling market stories, and confidently engage Product, field teams, customers, and analysts?

Be Part of Our Security Product Marketing Team

As APIs and AI agents transform how digital experiences and business processes are built, they also expand the attack surface and create new security challenges. This is a highly technical Product Marketing role with end-to-end go-to-market ownership for Akamai API Security and emerging AI and agent security capablities. You will help define how these solutions are positioned, launched, adopted, and understood in the market while developing the product depth to demonstrate them credibly and engage technical audiences. The right candidate combines the strong product marketing judgement with the curiosity and technical fluency to understand how the technology actually works.

Partner with the best

As a Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager, you will be the market-facing owner and technical product marketing lead for API Security and emerging agent security capabilities. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Solution Engineering, Sales, and the broader Marketing organization to turn product capabilities into differentiated positioning, compelling launches, field-ready enablement, and credible customer proof. You will be expected to independently develop deep product knowledge, run demos, understand architecture and deployment patterns, validate technical claims, and serve as a trusted face of the product with sellers, customers, partners, and analysts. This is not a pure engineering role, but it is also not a traditional content-only PMM role.

As a Senior Technical Marketing Engineer, you will be responsible for:

- Owning positioning, messaging, value propositions, buyer and audience strategy, competitive differentiation, and go-to-market plans for API Security and emerging AI and agent security capabilities
- Leading product launches end-to-end from roadmap and early planning through market readiness and post-launch adoption, including use cases, target audiences, differentiation, proof, enablement, and success metrics
- Developing deep product fluency by using Akamai products hands-on and understanding API traffic flows, integrations, deployment models, configuration patterns, limitations, and common troubleshooting scenarios
- Building and delivering compelling product demonstrations and technical storytelling for sellers, Solution Engineers, customers, partners, analysts, webinars, and industry events, while partnering with technical teams on deeper labs and reference architectures when needed
- Translating complex technical capabilities into clear market narratives and assets such as pitch decks, solution briefs, technical blogs, white papers, architecture content, competitive guidance, and customer-facing materials
- Driving field readiness and adoption by diagnosing why sellers or Solution Engineers are struggling, then creating discovery questions, demo scripts, objection handling, enablement sessions, workshops, and repeatable plays and measuring their effectiveness
- Partnering with Product Management and Engineering to validate technical claims, document assumptions, dependencies, and limitations, distinguish current capabilities from roadmap, and ensure public-facing messaging is accurate and defensible
- Bringing customer, field, and competitive insight into roadmap discussions and acting as a credible counterpart to Product Management, Engineering, and Solution Engineering on market and technical implications
- Engaging directly with developers, security architects, AppSec leaders, CISOs, customers, partners, and analysts, adapting technical depth and business value to each audience
- Operating as a self-starting owner in a fast-moving portfolio, prioritizing across launches, field opportunites, product requests, and campaigns while communicating tradeoffs work to completion

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

- Have 8+ years of relevant B2B technology experience including 4+ years in Product Marketing, Technical Product Marketing, or equivalent ownership of positioning, launches, field enablement, and go-to-market for technically complex products, and a Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent
- Demonstrate a track record of independently owning product or category positioning, launches, competitive strategy, field enablement, and adoption in cybersecurity, cloud, developer, or infrastructure markets
- Bring strong working knowledge of API Security and application security concepts, including API request flows, authentication and authorization, the OWASP API Security Top 10, API gateways, WAAP or WAF, runtime security, and common deployment and integration patterns
- Bring hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of AI agents, LLM application security, MCP, agent-to-tool and agent-to-API interactions, delegated access, and emerging agentic security risks
- Be able to independently learn and use technical products, configure and run common workflows, deliver live demos, inspect technical evidence, and troubleshoot enough to validate product behavior and claims
- Communicate complex technical information clearly to developers, security practitioners, architects, executives, analysts, sellers, and cross-functional teams, adapting the level of detail and value story to the audience
- Be able to work across Product Management, Engineering, Solution Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, challenge assumptions constructively, and make sound decisions with incomplete information

Build your career at Akamai

Our ability to shape digital life today relies on developing exceptional people like you. The kind that can turn impossible into possible. We’re doing everything we can to make Akamai a great place to work. A place where you can learn, grow and have a meaningful impact.

With our company moving so fast, it’s important that you’re able to build new skills, explore new roles, and try out different opportunities. We have all kinds of development opportunities available, from programs such as GROW and Mentoring, to internal events like the APEX Expo and tools such as Linkedin Learning, all to help you expand your knowledge and experience here.
